snippet.title: Tenchu: Return From Darkness | Xbox | 2003/2004 | Video Game US Trailer (1) | LQ/OGR
snippet.description:
US Trailer for the Tenchu: Return From Darkness video game, an enhanced port of Tenchu: Wrath of Heaven.

Original version of the game published in United States as Tenchu: Wrath of Heaven by Activision in 2003 for PlayStation 2
Published in United States as Tenchu: Return From Darkness by Activision in 2004 for Xbox
Developed/Ported by K2

Trailer in high quality. Upscaled from the Trailer in original resolution.
